name: OSHA filing window reminders
goal: Use the shared deadline tracker to remind customers about the Jan 2–Mar 2 filing window and the February 1–April 30 posting period.

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import json,os,pathlib; d=json.loads((pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures'/'osha-filing'/'deadline-status.json').read_text()); assert d['customer_submits'] and not d['certification_by_glacier']"
